literal_source: MzMLFile_test.cpp:238-267; unchanged original MzMLFile_1.mzML; all five published spectrum/chromatogram pairs copied verbatim.
derived_cases: Raw declared counts and negative -1 sentinel; metadataOnly stop before count.
Filtered count triggered at RT event, missing-field and precursor ordering/equality branches.
Reference group loop does not recheck skip flag between CV terms: multiple RT counts, unlike separate inline events.
Missing-RT incidental decoding deliberately removed; global skip_chromatograms coupling deliberately corrected.
Native XML/encoding/resource/path and early-reader-tail regressions use constructed inputs, not production-derived scientific expected values.
native_boundaries: Count-only output; no arbitrary header transport, consumer/transform or full MzMLFile claim.
No binary decoding, including missing-RT records; scientific/encoding fields outside counting are not consumed.
ISO-8859-1 only for ASCII bytes; no Latin-1 transcoding; UTF-8 BOM chunk-independent.
Strict XML, duplicate/consumed-reference, numeric and cumulative resource validation can reject source-permitted inputs.
Consumed declared/physical/returned count bounds also apply to ignored records; array limits do not apply.
Successful early stop does not drain XML/compression trailers; buffering may prefetch.

implementation_dependencies.name: quick-xml
implementation_dependencies.note: Existing optional mzML dependency. Public NsReader/get_mut APIs; raw XML accounting owned by bounded wrapper. No dependency/source modification.

review_fixes: Reserved ordered XML declaration attributes; source order is version, optional encoding, optional standalone.
Borrowed lexical attribute validation before owned map copying: valid qualified names, separation after quoted values, and no raw less-than byte in values.
Recognize BOM even across one-byte BufRead chunks; permit the original source fixture declaration only for consumed ASCII ISO-8859-1 bytes.
